summary: Every empty/comment-only catch block and empty .catch(() => {}) handler under src/main, src/renderer and src/server now logs through the module's scoped logger instead of swallowing the error, with log.warn for real failures and log.debug for expected/benign paths. A handful of sites (the logger's own write path, pointer-capture release/acquire) are deliberately left silent with an eslint-disable comment explaining why. A new no-restricted-syntax ESLint rule (src/** only) rejects both patterns going forward, so the count cannot silently regrow. No behavior changed: only logging was added, no new throws or changed return values.

reactNativeIos.reason: No files under apps/mobile were touched. The mobile app has its own logging conventions and was not audited as part of this pass.

nativeAndroid.reason: No files under apps/android were touched. Native Android was not audited as part of this pass.

storageDataMigration.reason: No schema, column, or migration behavior changed. The touched sites in src/main/db/database.ts and src/main/db/machines.ts are existing migration/parse catch blocks that now log their failure; no new table, column, or migration step was added.

updateRelease.reason: No wire protocol, version, or packaging change. This is a logging-only change plus a lint rule; nothing here affects update channels or release packaging.
